issues.label: Reviewability of summary judgment denial after trial
issues.why: Whether a denied summary-judgment motion is reviewable following a full jury trial on the merits.

issues.label: Meaning of 'deliberate removal' under 2745.01(C)
issues.why: The statute's scope depends on whether 'deliberate removal' requires an affirmative act of taking off a guard.

issues.label: Failure to repair/replace as removal
issues.why: Whether not restoring a guard that detached during use constitutes 'deliberate removal.'

issues.label: Identity of who removed the guard
issues.why: The presumption requires deliberate removal by the employer, so who removed it matters.

issues.label: Deliberateness of the removal
issues.why: A removal during a repair may be incidental rather than a deliberate decision to eliminate the guard.

issues.label: Direct-result causation requirement
issues.why: The presumption applies only if injury occurred as a direct result of the removal.

issues.label: Rebuttable presumption operation and burden shifting
issues.why: How the presumption of intent shifts and can be rebutted by the employer must be applied correctly.

issues.label: Sufficiency of evidence supporting jury verdict
issues.why: Whether trial evidence supports findings of deliberate removal, causation, and unrebutted intent.

issues.label: Statutory intent-to-injure element
issues.why: Liability requires proof of intent to injure or substantial certainty, a high threshold under 2745.01.

issues.label: Genuine issue of material fact standard
issues.why: Whether conflicting affidavits and evidence created a triable issue precluding summary judgment.

issues.label: Which guard is relevant to claim
issues.why: Evidence distinguishes PTO shaft guard from coupling guard, affecting removal and causation analysis.

issues.label: 2016 pump replacement as removal event
issues.why: Whether the 2016 repair requiring guard removal establishes deliberate removal by the employer.

issues.label: Employee's own conduct and comparative causation
issues.why: Camara operated the running machine to investigate a leak, raising proximate-cause questions.

issues.label: Jury instruction accuracy on removal definition
issues.why: Whether the court's expansive definition of 'deliberate removal' correctly stated the law.

issues.label: Interrogatory phrasing and consistency
issues.why: Whether interrogatories properly captured statutory elements and are consistent with the verdict.

issues.label: Effect of spoliation/altered document evidence
issues.why: Altered quote-to-invoice evidence bears on intent, credibility, and potential prejudice.

issues.label: Damages award support
issues.why: Whether the $1,934,000 compensatory award is supported by evidence.

issues.label: Employment and course-of-employment elements
issues.why: Statute requires the injury occur during course of employment to an employee.

issues.label: Rebuttal evidence sufficiency (interrogatory C)
issues.why: Whether owners' affidavits denying removal sufficed as a matter of law to rebut intent.

issues.label: Prejudice/harmless error from any SJ error
issues.why: Even if SJ denial erred, whether a full trial cured or rendered it harmless.
